headline: Stealth's crouton-alpha hits an all-time high of 3.8% token share, climbing three spots to No. 7
summary: The biggest story today is stealth/crouton-alpha, which set an all-time token-share record and jumped three places to rank 7. DeepSeek still holds the top spot at 35.8% of provider share, though it slipped 1.5% over the day.
highlights: Record: stealth/crouton-alpha reached 3.8% token share, its highest on record, up 3 places to No. 7.
The top two providers, DeepSeek and Tencent, hold 47.8% of tokens between them.
Tencent's provider share is up 7.3% over the past week, the largest weekly gain among the top providers.
New entrant: qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b debuts at rank 42 with 0.3% token share.
Dropout: perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2 falls out of the rankings from 51st place.
